subject: sliderInput ticks not alligning with values

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: sliderInput ticks not alligning with values
parts:
Hello,

I defined a sliderInput with sliderInput("foo","Foo", 2.6, 3.0, 2.8, step=0.1, width='100%'). The tick marks are not lining up with the allowed values. For example, this figure shows the handle at 2.7, but the tick mark is at 2.73.

What can I do to ensure the ticks allign with the values?

Jonathan

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: sliderInput ticks not alligning with values
parts:
Here's a little closer look. When I type the following in R, I get the output listed below. Notice data-scale has 4 pipes ( | ). Shouldn't it be 5? This seems like a bug in the sliderInput() function. How may I report this bug? Can anyone recommend a workaround?

In addition to the bug report, it would be nice to put in a feature request, for the ability to pass through html option overrides on the *Input functions. So something like "sliderInput(...,data-scale='|;|;|;|;|'.

R command:

Output:
<div>
  <label class="control-label" for="foo">Foo</label>
  <input id="foo" type="slider" name="foo" value="2.8" class="jslider" data-from="2.6" data-to="3" data-step="0.1" data-skin="plastic" data-round="FALSE" data-locale="us" data-format="#,##0.#####" data-scale="|;|;|;|" data-smooth="FALSE" data-width="100%"/>
</div>

messages.author: f1a78b77bed56547
messages.subject: Re: sliderInput ticks not alligning with values
parts:
Here's a workaround. I just added a small value to max.

sliderInput("foo","Foo", 2.6, 3.0 + 1e-6, 2.8, step=0.1, width='100%')

There I answered my own question. Am I just talking to myself out loud in this group? :)

Jonathan
